messages:
maria_support: FYI ticket from Acme — their traffic is being processed in us-west even though they set the client region to "eu-west". They pasted a header dump showing quotes around the region value.
acme_app: yes, our logs show higher latency (~220ms extra) and billing shows tokens charged in us-west. header we send: X-Redwood-Region: "eu-west"
mar ia_support: attaching the exact header snippet from their env: 
```
X-Redwood-Region: "eu-west"
User-Agent: AcmeService/2.1
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
```
devon_sdk: this rings a bell — SDK v1.4.2 added a small serialize step for headers when using the new http client; we accidentally .toString()-wrapped values. quick repro (node):
```
fetch(url, { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Region': JSON.stringify('eu-west') } })
// -> sends header value: "eu-west"
```
ingrid_sre: router logs show parse error when header includes a quote char. snippet: 
```
WARN router: region header parse failed for value '"eu-west"' -> fallback to default region: us-west (route-id=rt-09a)
```
ingrid_sre: result — fallback routing to default region, not a true regional mismatch. explains billing and latency.
carlos_oncall: can we hotpatch router to normalize by trimming leading/trailing quotes? that would be low-risk and cover other clients that accidentally quote. also need SDK patch so clients stop sending quoted values.
devon_sdk: i can ship SDK fix in v1.4.3 — stripQuotes before setHeader + add unit tests. plan: 1) publish 1.4.3-canary in ~2h, 2) GA in ~6h after canary looks good. workaround for customers: set region via query param or client config rather than raw header.
maria_support: customer asked for ETA and if we can apply a gateway rule while SDK patch rolls out.
ingrid_sre: gateway rule doable — create a header rewrite rule to strip leading/trailing double quotes on X-Redwood-Region. i'll open a small config PR to canary gateway in staging then prod. low risk.
region-router-bot: deploy start: gateway-rewrite/strip-quoted-region -> canary (deploy-id: d-9042)
devon_sdk: also adding server-side acceptance: router will treat quoted tokens same as unquoted for now (simple trim) to avoid more incidents. i'll add a regression test for token matching.
maria_support: told Acme the plan and ETA (6h for SDK GA + immediate gateway hotfix). they replied: 
acme_app: thanks! we'll apply our client workaround tonight and watch for the canary. appreciate the speedy response :thumbsup:
car los_oncall: leaving a note to follow up in 24h to confirm billing/lower latency.
mar ia_support: closing loop in ticket after follow-up.
